from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single liability metric extracted from one company's financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reported in the document")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item name, e.g., 'Total Current Liabilities'")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the metric as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the value, e.g., 'thousands', 'millions'")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date of the report")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the fact")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_records: list[FinancialLiabilityRecord]
